title: Shipping desk claims a Dubai consignment needs duty paid to a UPI ID
label: scam
synopsis: A caller from an 'international shipping desk' says undeclared gold is held in the victim's name, asks for secrecy, sets a same-day deadline and demands duty to a personal UPI ID.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Ravi calling from the international shipping desk. Is this Mr Anand Iyer?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, a consignment addressed to you from Dubai is held at the customs warehouse. It contains undeclared electronics and gold jewellery.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I wasn't expecting any parcel from Dubai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The officer says the sender used your name and mobile number. Unless the import duty is settled, a case will be registered against you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't speak to anyone about this parcel for now. It is a sensitive case and the sender may be watching you.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The duty office closes at five today. After that the goods are confiscated and your name goes on a watch list.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay twenty-two thousand rupees duty to the officer's UPI ID I am messaging you, and the case will be closed immediately.

claims.span: Pay twenty-two thousand rupees duty to the officer's UPI ID I am messaging you

title: Online partner pushes a secret trading pool before a midnight deadline
label: scam
synopsis: A partner met online, supposedly working on a ship, invites the victim into an uncle's trading pool, asks for secrecy from family, sets a deadline, asks for a deposit to an app wallet and refuses video.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey, it's Lena. Sorry I missed your message earlier, the shift on the ship ran long.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: No problem, how are you doing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Honestly I'm excited. My uncle's trading group made another big return this week, and I told him I'd bring you in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He only lets family and partners join, so please don't mention it to your sister. She would never understand us.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I'm not sure, I've never invested like that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The pool closes at midnight their time, and the bonus only applies to deposits made before then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just move five thousand dollars to the wallet in the app I sent, and we'll withdraw together once your profit doubles.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Can we talk on video first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The satellite link on board doesn't allow video, but I promise we'll meet when my contract ends.

claims.span: The satellite link on board doesn't allow video

title: Shopping-app 'customer care' reverses a failed refund through a UPI request
label: scam
synopsis: A caller posing as a shopping app's customer care says a refund failed, keeps the victim on the line, and gets them to approve a UPI collect request with their PIN.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from the customer care of your shopping app about the return you requested for the mixer grinder.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, I returned it last week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The refund of four thousand two hundred rupees failed because of a bank server issue, so we'll process it manually.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Keep this line connected and don't open any other app, or the refund window will reset.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, go ahead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've sent a request on your UPI app. Approve it and enter your PIN so the refund gets credited.

claims.span: Approve it and enter your PIN so the refund gets credited

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: It says debit of four thousand two hundred.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's only the display format, sir. The money comes to you, you just authorise it quickly within two minutes.

title: Enforcement Directorate 'interrogation' in a closed room
label: scam
synopsis: A caller posing as an ED officer claims a warrant, orders a video interrogation in a closed room, forbids contacting a lawyer, and demands savings be moved to an audit account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Assistant Director Sharma from the Enforcement Directorate. Am I speaking with Mrs Latha Menon?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes. Is something wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A bank account opened with your documents received illegal foreign transfers. The Supreme Court has issued a non-bailable warrant.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must join a video call now and stay in a closed room. No family member can be present during the interrogation.

claims.span: You must join a video call now and stay in a closed room

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I'm scared. Can I call my lawyer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you contact a lawyer or anyone else now, it will be treated as tampering with evidence.

claims.span: If you contact a lawyer or anyone else now, it will be treated as tampering with evidence

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Move all your savings into the audit account I will share. It will come back within three days once you are cleared.

claims.span: Move all your savings into the audit account I will share

title: Broadband 'network security team' wants remote access to clean a router
label: scam
synopsis: A caller claiming to be the broadband provider's security team reports overseas traffic from the router, tells the victim to avoid banking and email, threatens disconnection, and asks for a remote-session code.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the network security team from your broadband provider. Is this the person who holds the broadband account?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, that's me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We've detected unusual traffic from your home router. Someone overseas is using your connection to access bank websites.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't log into your banking or email until we clean the router. The attacker can see everything you type.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your connection will be cut off in fifteen minutes if we can't secure it, and reactivation takes a week.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Install the router protection tool from the link I texted, then tell me the session code it shows so our engineer can log in.

claims.span: tell me the session code it shows so our engineer can log in

title: Supplier contact redirects invoices to a 'new' bank account
label: scam
synopsis: A caller impersonating a known supplier contact announces a bank change after a 'merger', discourages calling their finance team, and pushes an overdue invoice to the new account today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Priya, this is Tom from Norland Supplies, we handle your packaging orders.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Hi Tom, how can I help?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our old account is being closed after a bank merger, so all payments from this month need to go to our new account.

claims.span: all payments from this month need to go to our new account

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our director signed off on it, and I'll email you the updated details straight after this call.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I'd normally confirm bank changes with your finance team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No need to call them, they're swamped with the audit. Just reply to my email and we'll sort it out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Invoice 5520 is already overdue, so please send it to the new account today to avoid the late fee.
